engine.text: Embedded LND {version:lnd-blixt} (Go); the on-chain wallet is btcwallet inside LND, run in-process through react-native-turbo-lnd

chain_data.text: Neutrino (BIP 157/158) light client through six default peers, four run by Blixt; the person can change the peers in Settings. Fee estimates come from a fixed URL.

libraries.text: React Native, react-native-turbo-lnd, @bufbuild/protobuf, secp256k1, bech32, react-native-nitro-tor, react-native-keychain, easy-peasy

bitcoin_library_not_counted: btcwallet (with btcd and neutrino), Go modules under LND

prebuilt.text: Lndmobile.xcframework (LND), downloaded from the react-native-turbo-lnd release for the pinned LND commit

patched: None in the app (no patch files); LND is Blixt's own fork (hsjoberg/lnd) with an added gossip speedloader
